key_insight: OpenPVMapper combines multiple complementary sources to create the first open, nationwide installation-level database of rooftop PV systems in mainland France.
engineering_relevance: The dataset can improve grid planning, PV siting analysis, and large-scale solar infrastructure studies by providing geographically comprehensive, source-traceable installation records.
method: Nationwide aerial-imagery deep learning detection of rooftop PV
Reconciliation with OpenStreetMap and a probabilistic building-level detection dataset
Per-installation provenance tracking with optional manual validation flags
evidence_signal: The database contains 1,135,850 installations totaling about 15.01 GWp, and manual review of 1,862 stratified samples estimates overall precision at roughly 74–75% with added gains from cross-source corroboration.
watch_item: Precision is still imperfect and depends on source agreement, so downstream analyses should account for false positives and provenance differences across methods.
paper_title: OpenPVMapper: A Multi-source, Nationwide Database of Rooftop Photovoltaic Systems in France
